command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=2ec11ced6cf40ec49443428eccd042b2de967a2b; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile test -- hardware-setup.test.tsx; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile build; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android >/dev/null; (cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug >/dev/null); APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; ADB=/opt/homebrew/bin/adb; "$ADB" start-server >/dev/null; SERIAL=''; TRANSPORT=''; for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do ENDPOINT="$("$ADB" mdns services 2>/dev/null | awk '/adb-RFCT70L7E8J/ && /_adb-tls-connect\._tcp/ {print $3; exit}')"; if [ -n "$ENDPOINT" ]; then "$ADB" connect "$ENDPOINT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; if "$ADB" devices -l | grep -F "$ENDPOINT" | grep -q ' device '; then SERIAL="$ENDPOINT"; TRANSPORT='WIFI'; break; fi; fi; sleep 1; done; if [ -z "$SERIAL" ] && [ "$("$ADB" -s RFCT70L7E8J get-state 2>/dev/null || true)" = device ]; then SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; TRANSPORT='USB'; fi; test -n "$SERIAL"; echo ADB_TRANSPORT=$TRANSPORT; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" install -r "$APK"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop link.localclimate.app; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity >/dev/null; echo INSTALLED_HEAD=$EXPECTED; echo INSTALLED_ON=$SERIAL
